title: Goodnight News
about: Proof cut of the 2026-10-22 Goodnight News script: the open, two stories (each body trimmed to its first sentence), the sign-off.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Good evening, and welcome back to Goodnight News — the channel bringing you good news from around the world.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Here is what the world got right today.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: First: Euclid discovers new comet. From the European Space Agency.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: The European Space Agency’s Euclid space telescope has discovered its first previously unknown comet, in images taken between 16 and 24 September 2026.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Second: Earth from Space: West Antarctica. From the European Space Agency.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: This image over part of West Antarctica was captured by Copernicus Sentinel-3 on 30 September 2026.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: That is the news the world got right today.

lines.speaker: anchor
lines.text: Sleep well. Same time tomorrow. Goodnight.
